action_and_boundary_conditions.quadratic_form: Q[f]=int_UV^IR du p(u) (d_u f)^2 + b_UV f(UV)^2 + b_IR f(IR)^2
action_and_boundary_conditions.restriction: b_UV>=0 and b_IR>=0; no boundary kinetic terms

evidence_boundary: The phase map proves what follows conditionally from a declared positive quadratic endpoint action. It neither derives b_UV or b_IR from the bulk, fixes ell, includes boundary kinetic terms, nor permits post-hoc selection using observations.

ir_only_no_go.statement: With UV Neumann data and b_IR>=0, the lightest mass is bounded above by the hard ND value; IR stiffness alone cannot make an order-one dimensionless mass.

numerics.method: linear finite elements plus sparse symmetric generalized eigensolve

prospective_scan_definition.selection_statement: The grid is fixed from the carrier and its NN spectral scale, before and without observational comparison.

stability.positive_quadrant_result: all points are stable; only rho_UV=rho_IR=0 has the exact zero mode

title: Prospective positive Robin boundary family
